---
title: "Excitation-Inhibition Balance Tuning via tvboptim"
---

Reproducing the FIC+EIB tuning workflow from [Schirner et al. (2023)](https://doi.org/10.1038/s41467-023-38626-y). Fits local inhibitory weights (J_i) for E-I balance and dual coupling weights (wLRE, wFFI) to match empirical functional connectivity.

```{python}
# | output: false
import os

os.environ["XLA_FLAGS"] = "--xla_force_host_platform_device_count=8"

from tvbo import SimulationExperiment
from matplotlib.colors import Normalize
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np

# Load experiment (network + target FC loaded from BIDS automatically)
exp = SimulationExperiment.from_file(
    "/Users/leonmartin_bih/tools/tvbo/database/experiments/EI_Tuning_FIC_EIB_Optimization.yaml"
)

# Run all algorithms: fic, fic_eib, eib
results = exp.run("tvboptim", mode="all")
```

```{python}
# Extract individual algorithm results
fic = results.fic
fic_eib = results.fic_eib
eib = results.eib

# Get target FC from network observations (loaded from BIDS)
fc_target = np.array(exp.network.observations['BoldCorrelation'])
```

## Results

```{python}
#| label: fig-ei-tuning-results
#| fig-cap: "**EI Tuning Results.** Row 1: FIC algorithm (local E-I balance). Row 2: Combined FIC+EIB algorithm. Row 3: EIB standalone (post-FIC refinement)."
#| fig-height: 14

cmap = plt.cm.cividis
accent_blue = cmap(0.3)
accent_gold = cmap(0.85)
accent_mid = cmap(0.6)

# 3 rows x 4 columns layout
mosaic = """
AABBCCDD
EEFFGGHH
IIJJKKLL
"""
fig, axes = plt.subplot_mosaic(mosaic, figsize=(16, 12))

# =============================================================================
# ROW 1: FIC Algorithm Results (Local E-I Balance Tuning)
# =============================================================================

# A: S_e Before FIC
ax = axes["A"]
data = np.array(fic.pre_tuning.data[:, 0, :])
norm = Normalize(vmin=data.mean(0).min(), vmax=data.mean(0).max())
for i in range(data.shape[1]):
    ax.plot(data[:, i], color=cmap(norm(data.mean(0)[i])), lw=0.5, alpha=0.6)
ax.axhline(0.25, color=accent_gold, ls='--', lw=2, label='Target')
ax.set(xlabel="Time step", ylabel="S_e", title="A. FIC: Before Tuning")
ax.set_ylim(0, 1)
ax.legend(loc='upper right')

# B: S_e After FIC
ax = axes["B"]
data = np.array(fic.post_tuning.data[:, 0, :])
norm = Normalize(vmin=data.mean(0).min(), vmax=data.mean(0).max())
for i in range(data.shape[1]):
    ax.plot(data[:, i], color=cmap(norm(data.mean(0)[i])), lw=0.5, alpha=0.6)
ax.axhline(0.25, color=accent_gold, ls='--', lw=2, label='Target')
ax.set(xlabel="Time step", ylabel="S_e", title="B. FIC: After Tuning")
ax.set_ylim(0, 1)
ax.legend(loc='upper right')

# C: FIC Convergence (Mean S_e over iterations)
ax = axes["C"]
mean_Se = np.array(fic.history.mean_S_e)
ax.plot(mean_Se, lw=2, color=accent_blue, label='Mean S_e')
ax.axhline(0.25, color=accent_gold, ls='--', lw=2, label='Target')
ax.set(xlabel="FIC iteration", ylabel="Mean S_e", title="C. FIC: Convergence")
ax.legend(loc='upper right')
ax.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# D: J_i Distribution (fitted inhibitory weights)
ax = axes["D"]
J_i = np.array(fic.state.dynamics.J_i).flatten()
ax.bar(range(len(J_i)), J_i, alpha=0.7, color=accent_mid)
ax.set(xlabel="Region", ylabel="J_i", title="D. FIC: Inhibitory Weights")
ax.grid(True, alpha=0.3, axis='y')

# =============================================================================
# ROW 2: FIC+EIB Combined Algorithm Results
# =============================================================================

# E: FC Target (empirical)
ax = axes["E"]
fc_plot = np.copy(fc_target)
np.fill_diagonal(fc_plot, np.nan)
im = ax.imshow(fc_plot, cmap='cividis', vmin=-0.2, vmax=0.9)
ax.set(title="E. Target FC (Empirical)")
plt.colorbar(im, ax=ax, fraction=0.046)

# F: FC after FIC+EIB
ax = axes["F"]
# Get final FC from fic_eib fc_buffer (not history)
fc_fic_eib = np.array(fic_eib.fc_buffer) if hasattr(fic_eib, 'fc_buffer') else None
if fc_fic_eib is not None and fc_fic_eib.ndim >= 2:
    # fc_buffer may be (n_regions, n_regions) or (iterations, n_regions, n_regions)
    if fc_fic_eib.ndim == 3:
        fc_fic_eib = fc_fic_eib[-1]  # Take last iteration
    fc_plot = np.copy(fc_fic_eib)
    np.fill_diagonal(fc_plot, np.nan)
    corr_fic_eib = float(fic_eib.history.fc_corr[-1]) if hasattr(fic_eib.history, 'fc_corr') else 0
    im = ax.imshow(fc_plot, cmap='cividis', vmin=-0.2, vmax=0.9)
    ax.set(title=f"F. FIC+EIB FC (r={corr_fic_eib:.3f})")
    plt.colorbar(im, ax=ax, fraction=0.046)
else:
    ax.text(0.5, 0.5, "N/A", ha='center', va='center', transform=ax.transAxes)
    ax.set(title="F. FIC+EIB FC")

# G: FIC+EIB Convergence (FC correlation)
ax = axes["G"]
ax2 = ax.twinx()
fc_corrs = np.array(fic_eib.history.fc_corr)
fc_rmses = np.array(fic_eib.history.fc_rmse)
l1, = ax.plot(fc_corrs, lw=2, color=accent_blue, label='FC Corr')
l2, = ax2.plot(fc_rmses, lw=2, color=accent_gold, label='FC RMSE')
ax.set(xlabel="FIC+EIB iteration", ylabel="FC Correlation", title="G. FIC+EIB: Convergence")
ax2.set_ylabel("FC RMSE")
ax.legend(handles=[l1, l2], loc='center right')
ax.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# H: wLRE Weights after FIC+EIB
ax = axes["H"]
wLRE = np.array(fic_eib.state.coupling.EIBLinearCoupling.wLRE)
im = ax.imshow(wLRE, cmap='cividis')
wLRE_corr = np.corrcoef(wLRE.flatten(), fc_target.flatten())[0, 1]
ax.set(title=f"H. FIC+EIB: wLRE (r={wLRE_corr:.3f})")
plt.colorbar(im, ax=ax, fraction=0.046)

# =============================================================================
# ROW 3: EIB Standalone (Post-FIC Refinement)
# =============================================================================

# I: FC after EIB (starting from FIC state)
ax = axes["I"]
# Get final FC from eib fc_buffer
fc_eib_final = np.array(eib.fc_buffer) if hasattr(eib, 'fc_buffer') else None
if fc_eib_final is not None and fc_eib_final.ndim >= 2:
    if fc_eib_final.ndim == 3:
        fc_eib_final = fc_eib_final[-1]
    fc_plot = np.copy(fc_eib_final)
    np.fill_diagonal(fc_plot, np.nan)
    corr_eib = float(eib.history.fc_corr[-1]) if hasattr(eib.history, 'fc_corr') else 0
    im = ax.imshow(fc_plot, cmap='cividis', vmin=-0.2, vmax=0.9)
    ax.set(title=f"I. EIB FC (r={corr_eib:.3f})")
    plt.colorbar(im, ax=ax, fraction=0.046)
else:
    ax.text(0.5, 0.5, "N/A", ha='center', va='center', transform=ax.transAxes)
    ax.set(title="I. EIB FC")

# J: EIB Convergence
ax = axes["J"]
ax2 = ax.twinx()
fc_corrs_eib = np.array(eib.history.fc_corr)
fc_rmses_eib = np.array(eib.history.fc_rmse)
l1, = ax.plot(fc_corrs_eib, lw=2, color=accent_blue, label='FC Corr')
l2, = ax2.plot(fc_rmses_eib, lw=2, color=accent_gold, label='FC RMSE')
ax.set(xlabel="EIB iteration", ylabel="FC Correlation", title="J. EIB: Convergence")
ax2.set_ylabel("FC RMSE")
ax.legend(handles=[l1, l2], loc='center right')
ax.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# K: wLRE after EIB
ax = axes["K"]
wLRE_eib = np.array(eib.state.coupling.EIBLinearCoupling.wLRE)
im = ax.imshow(wLRE_eib, cmap='cividis')
wLRE_eib_corr = np.corrcoef(wLRE_eib.flatten(), fc_target.flatten())[0, 1]
ax.set(title=f"K. EIB: wLRE (r={wLRE_eib_corr:.3f})")
plt.colorbar(im, ax=ax, fraction=0.046)

# L: wFFI after EIB
ax = axes["L"]
wFFI_eib = np.array(eib.state.coupling.EIBLinearCoupling.wFFI)
im = ax.imshow(wFFI_eib, cmap='cividis')
ax.set(title="L. EIB: wFFI")
plt.colorbar(im, ax=ax, fraction=0.046)

plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()

# =============================================================================
# Summary Statistics
# =============================================================================
print("\n" + "="*60)
print("EI TUNING SUMMARY")
print("="*60)

print(f"\nFIC (Local E-I Balance):")
print(f"  Final Mean S_e: {fic.history.mean_S_e[-1]:.4f} (target: 0.25)")
print(f"  J_i range: [{J_i.min():.3f}, {J_i.max():.3f}]")

print(f"\nFIC+EIB (Combined):")
print(f"  Final FC correlation: {fic_eib.history.fc_corr[-1]:.4f}")
print(f"  Final FC RMSE: {fic_eib.history.fc_rmse[-1]:.4f}")

print(f"\nEIB (Post-FIC Refinement):")
print(f"  Final FC correlation: {eib.history.fc_corr[-1]:.4f}")
print(f"  Final FC RMSE: {eib.history.fc_rmse[-1]:.4f}")
print(f"  Improvement over FIC+EIB: Δr = {eib.history.fc_corr[-1] - fic_eib.history.fc_corr[-1]:+.4f}")
```
